newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bital seeks 90 mln peso capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Bital seeks 90 mln peso capital increase.

text.p: Bital, the banking unit of Grupo Financiero Bital SA, said on Wednesday it would raise 90 million pesos in fresh capital via a 7.5 million-share rights offering to existing shareholders.
In a statement sent to the Mexican Stock Exchange, it said the capital increase was agreed at a board meeting on March 20 and is part of a long-term capitalization plan.

It said the rights offering would be done before March 31. It would involve 3.825 million "A" shares and 3.675 million "B" shares, with 3.40909091 shares issued per 100 shares owned. The price would be 12 pesos per share.
